prompt: Objective: decide whether a toothpaste maker should launch refill tablets. What you've learned: the target market is $200M. Latest finding: consumer tests show strong interest but low willingness to pay a premium. What is the best next step?

options.text: Size the market in other countries
Ask the interviewer what price point the client prefers here
options.feedback: Drive the case: work out what price makes sense.

options.text: Estimate revenue at a premium price
options.feedback: The finding says consumers won't pay a premium.

options.text: Check profitability near the regular toothpaste price
options.feedback: Right. Interest is high but premiums are not, so profitability at a standard price decides it.

explanation: Interest is strong but willingness to pay a premium is low. Check profitability at a near-regular price.
